stories.title: En Espagne, des inondations et des pluies torrentielles provoquent la mort de deux personnes dans la province de Barcelone

en.title: In Spain, flooding and torrential rains cause two deaths in Barcelona province
en.summary: Severe storms that began Thursday and prompted cancellation of a housing rights demonstration in Barcelona on Saturday have killed two people in the province, with at least one person missing.

stories.title: Ukraine : un pont de Kiev attaqué par un drone lors de la visite du chancelier allemand Friedrich Merz

en.title: Ukraine: a Kiev bridge attacked by drone during German Chancellor Friedrich Merz's visit
en.summary: A bridge in Kiev was targeted by a drone attack while German Chancellor Friedrich Merz was visiting Ukraine, following drone alerts issued by Ukrainian authorities toward the capital.

stories.title: Des pluies torrentielles s’abattent sur l’Espagne : deux morts dans la province de Barcelone, en état d'alerte

en.title: Torrential rains strike Spain: two dead in Barcelona province, on alert
en.summary: Heavy rainfall across Spain has killed two people in Barcelona province, with emergency services rescuing individuals trapped in vehicles by flooding in Granollers and surrounding areas.

stories.title: Pluies torrentielles en Espagne : deux morts dans la province de Barcelone, en état d’alerte

en.title: Torrential rains in Spain: two dead in Barcelona province, on alert
en.summary: Torrential storms in Spain have killed two people in Barcelona province and forced cancellation of a housing rights demonstration on Saturday, with conditions expected to end on Sunday.

stories.title: Un pont de Kiev frappé pendant la venue du chancelier allemand dans la capitale ukrainienne

en.title: A Kiev bridge struck during German Chancellor's visit to Ukrainian capital
en.summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz visited Kiev on Sunday to demonstrate support for Ukraine as the capital faces increased Russian attacks, including a strike on a bridge.

stories.title: EN DIRECT, guerre en Ukraine : le chancelier allemand, Friedrich Merz, est à Kiev, où « des accords importants seront conclus », déclare Volodymyr Zelensky

en.title: LIVE, war in Ukraine: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz is in Kiev, where "important agreements will be concluded", declares Volodymyr Zelensky
en.summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz visited Kiev, with Ukrainian President Zelensky announcing that important agreements would be reached and that decisions were being prepared to strengthen defense capabilities.

stories.title: Belfort : après l’agression d’un policier près d’un lycée bloqué, une enquête ouverte pour meurtre et deux personnes en garde à vue

en.title: Belfort: after assault on officer near blocked school, murder investigation opened and two people in custody
en.summary: A murder investigation was opened following an assault on a police officer near a blocked school in Belfort, with two people detained. The prosecutor will hold a briefing to update on the inquiry.

stories.title: Un pont de Kiev attaqué par un drone russe pendant la visite surprise du chancelier allemand, Friedrich Merz, dans la capitale ukrainienne

en.title: A Kiev bridge attacked by Russian drone during surprise visit of German Chancellor Friedrich Merz to Ukrainian capital
en.summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz made a surprise visit to Kiev, stating Ukraine needs support in the coming weeks. Russia continues to bomb essential infrastructure across the country.

stories.title: Ukraine : en pleine visite non annoncée de Friedrich Merz, un pont de Kyiv attaqué par un drone

en.title: Ukraine: Kyiv bridge attacked by drone during unannounced Friedrich Merz visit
en.summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz made an unannounced visit to Ukraine on October 4, occurring shortly after Russia warned diplomats and foreigners to leave Kyiv and threatened massive retaliatory strikes.

stories.title: Visite imprévue du chancelier allemand à Kiev : "Merz arrive avec des annonces très concrètes"

en.title: Unannounced visit by German Chancellor to Kyiv: "Merz arrives with very concrete announcements"
en.summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz made a surprise visit to Ukraine amid high tensions with Moscow, with discussions focused on Germany's support and concrete measures for Ukraine.

stories.title: En direct : Friedrich Merz en visite surprise à Kiev, un pont de nouveau touché par une frappe russe

en.title: Live: Friedrich Merz on surprise visit to Kyiv as Russian strike hits bridge again
en.summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz arrived in Kyiv on Sunday for a surprise visit following Moscow's warning to foreigners, with a Russian strike hitting the North bridge shortly after his arrival.

stories.title: «L’Ukraine a besoin de tout notre soutien» : le chancelier allemand Friedrich Merz est arrivé à Kiev pour une visite imprévue

en.title: "Ukraine needs all our support": German Chancellor Friedrich Merz arrives in Kyiv for unannounced visit
en.summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz arrived in Kyiv for an unannounced visit, pledging continued German support to President Zelensky and accompanied by Economy Minister Katherina Reiche.

stories.title: L’État loue un deuxième Falcon 8X à Dassault Aviation

en.title: The State Leases a Second Falcon 8X from Dassault Aviation
en.summary: France is leasing a second Falcon 8X aircraft from Dassault Aviation and will temporarily grant it military aircraft status. This is the second such aircraft leased within three weeks.

stories.title: G20 : comment la Chine a fait dérailler l’offensive américaine sur les surcapacités

en.title: G20: How China Derailed the American Offensive on Industrial Overcapacity
en.summary: China blocked G20 consensus on industrial overcapacity, a priority issue pushed by the United States and largely directed at Beijing. The disagreement reflects a broader division between the US and several partners over using tariffs as commercial leverage.

stories.title: « C’est comme disputer la finale de Ligue des champions » : Le jockey Cristian Demuro dépeint la singularité du Prix de l’Arc de Triomphe

en.title: "It's Like Playing a Champions League Final": Jockey Cristian Demuro Describes the Uniqueness of the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe
en.summary: Jockey Cristian Demuro, a two-time winner, is aiming for a third victory at the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe. The 105th edition takes place on October 4 at 4:05 PM.

stories.title: La Provence sera la première Fremm à déployer le drone S-100 au printemps

en.title: The Provence Will Be the First Fremm to Deploy the S-100 Drone in Spring
en.summary: The multi-mission frigate will undergo seven months of maintenance during which it will receive integration of an S-100 helicopter drone system for the first time on this ship type, plus a Stir radar fire control system.

stories.title: Sécheresse : l’élevage français redoute un automne sous tension

en.title: Drought: French livestock farming fears a tense autumn
en.summary: French livestock farmers face significant challenges heading into autumn due to drought, heat waves, and insufficient feed supplies, prompting some to conduct early slaughters. The situation is expected to be discussed at a major livestock summit opening in Auvergne.
